name: Chord with update-based soft-normalized forces
tagline: Use the soft-normalized branch output as the direction of the position update.
description: Attention and MLP outputs enter the position write as per-token displacements with a fixed soft RMS scale of 0.05. The h-only learned modulation, split position steps, and tangent velocity write match the native-zero control.
mechanism: Update-based branch force with F / sqrt(mean(F²) + 0.05²)
Existing split position step and spherical retraction
Native-zero output projections and learned h-only read, position and velocity scales
limitations: Bounded 8,000-update research comparison on the reference schedule.
